title: MAGNET: Improving the Multilingual Fairness of Language Models with Adaptive Gradient-Based Tokenization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating tokenization disparities (over-segmentation) by computing the average number of tokens per sentence on a parallel corpus (FLORES-200) across nine languages with different scripts (Latin, Cyrillic, and Indic), as well as comparing downstream task performance (accuracy) and inference times across these languages.
